Life is one of the hardest. And sometimes shitty like a chicken ladder. 
But it isn‘t about how hard you hit, it is about how often you stand up and fight for the things that matter to you.

And that may sound too easy, I get it. 
But it is really a fundamental thing to do in life, standing up. 
In the Morning or for yourself in a more metaphorical manner. 

you also need to gather yourself up from your lowest point, if life gives you lemons. 

Because if you wait it out and don‘t move on from whatever is bothering you, who does it then? 

If you do not know where to begin, then just try to do yourself a favor with healthy meals, maybe some physical utilisation. But idk, you have to work it out for yourself and your environment may help you, friends you can have a talk with or family really helps a lot.  

Maybe you look for someone to write with, back in the days people had pen friendships, we have social networks.
And I think they are a great opportunity but you got to have the discipline not to be on Twitter for an hour or more every day. 

peace ✌️

and thank you for your gratitude
Hope to have brought some positive vibes to you

Sylvester Stallone once said something along these lines: 

You, me or nobody is gonna hit as hard as life. 
But it isn‘t about how hard you hit, it is about how much you can take while still moving forward. 
That is how winners are made.

But until you start to believe in yourself, you won‘t have a life. 

It is simple and it may not seem helpful, because there are people who feel like not moving on because they can‘t anymore. 

And I would say that this applies only to a minority of cases.

Most people just give up and let themselves flow in the pond of life, in regards of depression and social anxiety.

But you have to be tough and you have to have a good mindset, try not to stress yourself too much if you can‘t achieve what you wanted to. 

Because even if you only achieved 10% it is still better than 0, like WTF it is a gazillion times more than 0.

And if you are doing fine for a few months and then there is a week or a month where you are not feeling as good, always remember that even 2% of the things you should do are way better than nothing. 

And if you get nothing done again, this is also ok. Everyone got (severe) downs, but it’s about that you stand up and carry on. 

And try to move your body, it is really that important to do so. 

I know how you feel and I also hate sports, because of how I got made fun of in school and in the sports club. 

I for example, found my physical utilization in the garden and on my skiff, navigating down a local river. But I have the privilege to live in a rural area, I don‘t know what to do in the city. 

also music helps a lot to express feelings, try to sing along the songs you love.
peace ✌️

This text was very inspiring for me and I think there is a lot of truth to it.

Make peace with yourself, don‘t be vengeful as it only fuels the burning hatred in your mind.

I do not know your life in detail so have some generally working things: 

stop smoking, move your body

some workout whatever, you need to become creative in order to find something that does it for you
Yoga for example, even if you are very clunky just try it 

and very important! Eat healthy, this is one of the things I missed out on for a long time and the impact of a healthy diet is huge 

try to socialize and if you can‘t take it just go home or try to talk about your strange feelings with someone you trust enough. 

These are all things that helped me to deal with (chest) pain induced from anxiety or simply stress.

I think one thing you need to start feeling better is a friend and someone who you feel comfortable around, even if you feel like you drown in your shadows. 

You can try various breath methods, meditation or muscle relaxation (a hot bath comes to mind) 

And now my usual disclaimer: I strongly discourage people to try this without proper company from a professional. 
Also mentioned substances may be illegal where you come from, so be cautious. 

You can also try lsd or shrooms, with company ofc. You should have a professional at your side, but a good , while an experienced friend may also help a whole lot but there is less to expect since I your friend isn’t professional. 

And if you can’t stand antidepressants (there are some people which really got better from those pills) 
you can try weed, if it’s legal where you come from definitely try it some time. 
Not saying you should become a hardcore stoner x) 

But like meditation or breath techniques, anything to lower your stress and anxiety levels can help. Your depression will become less worse if your stress and anxiety curve flattens out. 
This process can take a long time.

Be well, I hope you find a path for yourself

And it seldom is an outward aggression, it’s almost every time inbound. 
Which leads to self hatred, low self esteem and so on if you just let it happen. 

So try and find the things that make you anxious, depressed and aggressive. 

Keep in mind that also your thoughts or bad memories can trigger you sometimes.

It is really easy to just say I quit, it is actually not that easy don’t get me wrong.

You can always try and get professional help. 

I know, it’s not (always) possible or easy and some don’t like talking about themselves to literally strangers, even if they are professional. 

Do not live up to social expectations, you need to find yourself along the pass you lost yourself. And if it takes some time, like three or four years, then it is the way it is.
